President Donald Trump’s approval rating is underwater in 11 states that the president won by double digits in the 2024 election, Newsweek reports, a potentially troubling sign as the crucial fall midterm elections approach.

Trump has a 36% approval rating nationwide, according to Civiqs’ online tracking poll of registered voters.

The president’s disapproval rating is 59%, the rolling poll shows, leaving Trump deeply underwater with a net approval rating of -24%.
